text:
ian_sales: Received presales checklist from NorthernCredit: CA-only POC request. Requirements: inference + application logs must remain in ca-central-1 for the POC window; strict no-EU egress (including backups), BYOK with customer HSM, and a redacted sub-processor list that shows any parties that could touch request metadata. Also need rough delta pricing vs our hosted tier and estimate for peering + key onboarding. Can infra/security/ops confirm?

hannah_infra: Short: Hosted public API won't satisfy CA-only due to control-plane/telemetry. Options that work: Private single-region (customer control plane + BYOK) or Dedicated with tenant pinning and deny-rules. If they absolutely disallow any cross-region failover, we recommend Private. If they allow warm-standby to US, Dedicated pinned to ca-central-1 + failover to us-east is viable.

hannah_infra: Policy example we use (human-readable):
```
tenant_pin: ca-central-1
allowed_regions: [ca-central-1]    # or include us-east-1 if warm standby allowed
deny_regions: [eu-*]
control_plane_policy: telemetry_allowed=false  # note: hosted ignores this
```

kevin_sec: We can produce a redacted subprocessor mapping filtered to Canada that lists cloud infra, logging pipeline, and monitoring. Full, detailed inventory requires NDA. BYOK/HSM: customer-managed HSM in Private is the cleanest path. Dedicated supports managed-HSM and partner-HSM options but has an added compliance review. Key onboarding + KMS attestation typically 7-20 business days depending on their paperwork. Also need to confirm whether they require push of raw logs to their SIEM or in-region syslog forwarding.

laura_legal: We can add a contractual "no EU egress" clause for the POC, but we must enumerate exceptions (critical security alerts, legal subpoenas, vulnerability patches). Ask their counsel to define "no egress": data plane only, or includes control plane/diagnostics? We'll need the customer's legal contact and a signed NDA before sharing the full subprocessor matrix.

peering_team: For peering, we'll need ASNs, CIDR ranges, expected throughput, and TLS SANs. Typical interconnect lead time: 3-12 business days depending on their carrier. Note: any cross-region failover will cause egress billing and potential latency; surface that in the SOW. If they want private connectivity to a Private deployment, lead time is similar but we need a support window for routing cutover.

ian_sales: Pricing ask: ballpark delta vs hosted for a 30-day POC?

hannah_infra: Ballpark numbers: Private single-region POC with BYOK/customer-HSM: "$25k-$35k" for month (includes infra + onboarding). Dedicated pinned POC: "$12k-$18k"/mo + managed-HSM add-on "$3k-$5k"/mo. One-time peering/onboarding: "$1k-$3k". Exact depends on GPU profile and retention settings for logs. I'll follow up with a formal quote.

kevin_sec: I'm prepping a redacted in-region subproc list and partial security questionnaire answers we can share pre-NDA. Will flag anything that has EU-facing control-plane dependencies.

laura_legal: I'll draft the NDA + POC amendment language for "no EU egress" and follow up on acceptable exceptions. Please collect their legal contact info.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket PRESALES-7124 -> ca-poc-byo-hsm; linked to sales pipeline and peering-team.

ian_sales: Thanks all. I'll send NDA and their security questionnaire to their counsel. Please DM me the formal quote and an ops checklist I can include in the SOW. :thumbsup:
